people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
translations.bsb: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
